page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening, the main text block) with running head at top; main text in one column; a narrow column of marginal notes at the right edge, partly cut off by the gutter, not legible enough to transcribe. A digitiser's banner at the bottom is ignored.

main_text.p: altè mentis aurem obturaverat generosus Puer. Igitur Rex ad Constantinum suum revertitur ( quia jam ad omne scelus projectus videbatur, qui nuper Christianam, id est mitem illam & teneram pietatem, protritum iverat sub pedibus ) & palpans : Constantine, inquit, tempus jam dudum & res ipsa postulant, ut stem promissis, & obsequiis in me tuis aliquando respondeam. Sed non sentis alienatos à te tuorum animos? Quò res vergat, non percipis ? Sceptrum quod jus & natura tibi dederant, excussum de manibus non vides ? Primus ego rebus tuis consulam : Dic age: si patrem tuum hujus in te consilii architectum, fratremque qui te supplantavit, tibi sisterem: Tantùmne animi, ut acinacem strinxeris, & iniquum illud filum, quo corona perduellionis immi- net vertici, recideris ? Exercitu mea stipa-

page.notes: Marginal notes at the right edge are cut off by the gutter and largely illegible; not transcribed. Catchword "stipa-" is the hyphenated start of the next page word, given at the end of the text as printed.
